bundle.shortDescription: Deterministic simulation, fault injection and verification workbench
bundle.longDescription: Configure ground-vehicle and rocket powered-landing missions, inject faults, compare controllers, inspect requirement and invariant verdicts judged on the true state, replay runs by recomputation and export evidence packages. Idealised research models; not flight or vehicle software.
